In mathematics, a '''Dold manifold''' is one of the [[manifold]]s <math>P(m,n) = (S^m \times \mathbb{CP}^n)/\tau</math>, where <math>\tau</math> is the involution that acts as &minus;1 on the [[n-sphere|''m''-sphere]] <math>S^m</math> and as [[complex conjugation]] on the [[complex projective space]] <math>\mathbb{CP}^n</math>. These manifolds were constructed by {{harvs|txt|first=Albrecht|last=Dold|author-link=Albrecht Dold|year=1956}},<ref>{{Citation | last=Dold | first=Albrecht |author-link=Albrecht Dold| title=Erzeugende der Thomschen Algebra <math>\mathcal{N}</math> | doi=10.1007/BF01473868 | mr=0079269 | year=1956 | journal=[[Mathematische Zeitschrift]] | issn=0025-5874 | volume=65 | issue=1 | pages=25–35}}</ref> who used them to give explicit generators for [[René Thom]]'s [[unoriented cobordism ring]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.map.mpim-bonn.mpg.de/Dold_manifold|title=Dold manifold|website=www.map.mpim-bonn.mpg.de|publisher=The Manifold Atlas Project|access-date=May 2, 2022}}</ref> Note that <math>P(m,0)=\mathbb{RP}^m</math>, the [[real projective space]] of dimension ''m'', and <math>P(0,n)=\mathbb{CP}^n</math>.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Ucci |first=John James |year=1965 |title=Immersions and embeddings of Dold manifolds |url=https://core.ac.uk/download/pdf/82435349.pdf |journal=[[Topology (journal)|Topology]] |volume=4 |issue=3 |pages=283–293 |doi=10.1016/0040-9383(65)90012-1|mr=0187250 }}</ref>
